content.short: W-Coin is a community-driven tap-to-earn game with multi-blockchain support for claiming rewards.
content.description: W-Coin is a community-centric 'tap-to-earn' game that stands out by offering users the choice of multiple blockchains for their token claims, including TON, Ethereum, and Solana. This multi-chain approach empowers the community to decide on the project's direction while enjoying simple, engaging gameplay. W-Coin focuses on fair distribution and community governance, using the accessible Telegram interface to build a massive global following and educate users on the benefits of different blockchain networks.
content.meta: Choose your chain and earn with W-Coin. The multi-chain tap-to-earn game on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
